rules.compares: Breach notice period: DPA vs answer
rules.result: CONFLICT if both state a number and they differ; PARTIAL if only one states a number. 'Without undue delay' is not a number.
rules.title: Breach notice period
rules.whyItMatters: Your incident plan depends on the time the contract gives you, not the time in a questionnaire answer.
rules.suggestedAsk: Your answer and the DPA give different breach notification periods. Please confirm the period that applies and update the DPA if needed.

rules.compares: Deletion or return period: DPA vs answer
rules.title: Deletion and return period
rules.whyItMatters: After the contract ends, the DPA decides how long your data stays with the vendor.
rules.suggestedAsk: Your answer and the DPA give different deletion or retention periods. Please confirm the period that applies and update the DPA if needed.

rules.compares: Sub-processor names: DPA list vs answer
rules.result: CONFLICT if the answer names an entity not in the DPA list, or says none while the DPA lists some.
rules.title: Sub-processors
rules.whyItMatters: Art. 28(2) GDPR ties sub-processors to your authorisation, so the list in the contract has to match reality.
rules.suggestedAsk: Your answers and the DPA's sub-processor list do not match. Please send the complete current list with each sub-processor's name, purpose and location.

rules.result: CONFLICT if the answer says EU/EEA only while the DPA mentions non-EEA locations.
rules.title: Data location and transfers
rules.whyItMatters: A claim that data stays in the EU/EEA matters for transfer rules in Chapter V GDPR.
rules.suggestedAsk: Your answer says data stays in the EU/EEA, but the DPA names a location outside it. Please confirm where data is processed and the transfer mechanism used.

rules.result: CONFLICT if the answer allows audits and the DPA excludes them; PARTIAL if the DPA limits audits to reports.
rules.title: Audit rights
rules.whyItMatters: Art. 28(3)(h) GDPR covers audits and inspections; a narrower contract term limits what you can actually do.
rules.suggestedAsk: Your answer describes audit rights that the DPA does not give. Please confirm which audit rights apply and add them to the DPA if needed.

rules.compares: Use of customer data for AI training
rules.title: Use of data for AI training
rules.whyItMatters: Whether your data trains the vendor's models is a purpose question; the contract wording is what binds the vendor.
rules.suggestedAsk: Your answer and the DPA disagree on whether customer data is used to train AI or machine learning models. Please confirm which is correct and align the DPA.

rules.compares: Security claims in answers absent from the DPA or annex
rules.result: INFO: claim not reflected in the contract.
rules.title: Claim not in the contract
rules.whyItMatters: DPAs need not list every control, but a claim that is not in the contract is not a contractual commitment.
rules.suggestedAsk: Please send evidence for this claim (for example a certificate or report), or add it to the DPA's security annex.
